§6Cooling Towers and Condenser§f

§aYour cracking tower produces waste steam. This is how you turn it back into water.§f

The §bCatalytic Cracking Tower§f outputs low-pressure steam after every operation. Without a way to condense it back into water, your whole setup stalls. Four tiers exist, each faster than the last.

§bSteam Condenser§f (Crafting Table): §e2,000 mB/s§f rate. Made from §e2×§f Steel Ingot, §e4×§f Iron Plate, §e1×§f Cast Copper Plate. Good enough for a single cracking tower.

§bAuxiliary Cooling Tower§f (Tier 3 Anvil): §e20,000 mB/s§f. §e64×§f Concrete Bricks, §e128×§f Iron Bars, §e4×§f Steam Condensers.

§bCooling Tower§f (Tier 4 Anvil): §e200,000 mB/s§f. The iconic hyperbolic shape. §e128×§f Concrete, §e32×§f Steel Scaffold, §e16×§f Steam Condensers.

§bHigh-Power Steam Condenser§f (Assembly Machine): §e20,000,000 mB/s§f, but it needs power. §e8×§f Welded Steel Plate, §e4×§f Welded Cadmium Steel Plate, §e16×§f Copper Plate, §e3×§f Desh Motor, §e24×§f Steel Pipe.

§ePS:§f Low-pressure steam condenses at §e1:1§f into water. Start with a basic condenser and upgrade as your refinery scales up.
